# Review sheets index (MASTER_PROMPT_v4 5.12) -- generated by scripts/review_folder.py

Numbers are copied from each read's stats JSON (rule 5.5 as implemented in rule55.py). Overlays are derived views for eyes only. To keep clones small, the 150 overlay PNGs (1.4 GB) are no longer in the release tree; each overlay link points to the file at commit 71720ce, where it remains in git history.
